meta.name: ddlc-palette
meta.note: Colours measured from the official site: main.css for the interface, images/tilebg.png for the background, the sticker_?.png sprites for the characters and the uniform they wear, images/screen2.png for the two tones no sprite holds, images/screen5.png for the reds. Every hex here is a value the site actually ships

dot.where: the dots of the background grid
dot.source: images/tilebg.png, 200x200 tile, dots of radius 40 on a half-step offset grid

monikaEye.where: Monika — eyes; the palette's only green that is not dark
monikaEye.source: images/sticker_m.png, her iris — a ramp of 64 shades over 68 pixels with no commonest one, so this is the mean of its saturated greens

sayoriEye.where: Sayori — eyes; the palette's only light blue
sayoriEye.source: images/sticker_s.png, the dominant shade of her iris — the only bright sky blue on the sprite

yuriShadow.where: Yuri — hair out of the light; the darkest tone the palette has
yuriShadow.source: images/sticker_y.png, her hair where the light does not reach

jacket.where: the palette's only mid grey — comments, disabled text
jacket.source: the sticker_?.png sprites, the school jacket in the light

skirt.source: the sticker_?.png sprites, the pleated skirt

ribbon.where: the dark green — no sprite holds a green this deep
ribbon.source: images/screen2.png, the poem notebook's cover and ribbon

rule.where: the middle blue — the one colour that reads on white and on ink alike
rule.source: images/screen2.png, the ruled lines the poems are written on

bow.source: images/screen5.png, the flat fill of Sayori's hair bow (sticker_s.png carries the same hex)

bowShadow.source: images/screen5.png, the shaded fold of the same bow

base16.note: Slots hold palette key names, not hex, so a re-measured colour reaches the schemes without editing this. base00-base07 run background to foreground and are ordered by luminance; no colour may fill two slots of one variant. The palette is polarised — a colour that reads on ink is a pastel on paper — so the two variants draw different accents, each picked to clear 3:1 against its own background. The site ships no yellow and no orange, so base09 and base0A carry the warm character colours in both
